objects.name: Chipkin Example B-EM
objects.note: the device itself; the instance is configurable with --deviceID (default 389015). The stack rows are device-wide facts only the stack knows - the protocol version and revision it implements, the services and object types it was configured with, the live object list and address-binding table. The accepted rows are the stack's configured defaults for APDU limits, segmentation, system status and database revision; an application that answered them from its own constants could contradict the stack, so this example does not. The exception is Number_Of_APDU_Retries, served as 3 (the cl. 12.11.29 suggested default): this device sends ConfirmedEventNotifications, and the stack default 0 never resends one a recipient missed. APDU_Timeout stays at the stack's 10000 ms, cl. 12.11.28's default for a device that does not let it be modified

objects.name: Bronze
objects.note: REAL, degrees Celsius; starts at 21.5. F-COVM: Present_Value AND Status_Flags are both marked subscribable (SetPropertySubscribable), so a SubscribeCOVPropertyMultiple naming both fires one multi-property notification when the up/down keys nudge this value

objects.name: Vermilion
objects.note: BACnet/IP; Network_Type and Protocol_Level are set from BACnetStack_AddNetworkPortObject()'s arguments (IPv4, BACnet Application) at start-up, not a GetProperty callback like the object's other app-served rows; Changes_Pending is likewise computed and answered natively by the stack's Network Port object. Reliability has no fault condition this example detects, so it is accepted at the generic default (normal)

objects.name: Maroon
objects.note: F-ELEVATOR (canonical). Machine_Room_ID, Group_ID and Group_Members are NOT stack DEFAULTS - they are genuinely stored and served by BACnetStack_AddElevatorGroupObject (Group_Members is also maintained by BACnetStack_AddLiftOrEscalatorObject as Lift 1/Mauve is added to this group). They are marked accepted only because property-profile-reference.md's generic per-type table does not know about this object-specific host-configuration API and so cannot credit them as stack-served. isGroupOfLifts=true (enables Group_Mode) and supportLandingCallStatus=false (it would also add Landing_Call_Control, which cl. 12.58.10 requires to be writable if present); Landing_Calls is enabled on its own with SetPropertyEnabled (see the Lift's note for how the four F-ELEVATOR list/sequence callbacks are exercised) but property-profile-reference.md's generic Elevator Group table does not mark either 'required', so neither generates a checked row here - Group_Mode is served by GetPropertyEnumerated (normal) and Landing_Calls by GetListElevatorGroupLandingCallStatus (no calls outstanding: the callback returns false on its first call, the empty-list answer) regardless

objects.name: Mauve
objects.note: F-ELEVATOR (canonical). The Lift presents the car SIMULATION (simulation/ElevatorCar.cpp; README 'What is Simulation'): Car_Position and Car_Moving_Direction via GetPropertyUnsignedInteger/GetPropertyEnumerated, Car_Door_Status (one door, index 1) via GetPropertyEnumerated with useArrayIndex - SAFETY_LOCKED while the car moves, OPENING/OPENED/CLOSING/CLOSED at a stop - Passenger_Alarm and Out_Of_Service via GetPropertyBool, and Fault_Signals (the car's active BACnetLiftFaults: DOOR_CLOSING_FAULT when a door fails to close) via GetListOfEnumerations. Every change goes to the stack with BACnetStack_UpdateValue. property-profile-reference.md's generated Lift table is INCOMPLETE relative to CASBACnetStackDLL.h's doc comment for BACnetStack_AddLiftOrEscalatorObject (a documentation gap in the stack repo, not a stack API gap): it omits those six required properties; this example serves them because clause 12.59 requires them. Status_Flags, Elevator_Group, Group_ID and Installation_ID ARE in the generic table (stack-computed/stack-stored) and are accepted for the same reason as Maroon's. Event reporting, both algorithms clause 12.59 names: CHANGE_OF_STATE on Passenger_Alarm (pAlarmValues TRUE; the 's' key or the test-only control channel presses the button) and FAULT_LISTED on Fault_Signals, both to Notification Class 1 (Crimson). Reliability is enabled for the fault algorithm and computed by the stack from it (NO_FAULT_DETECTED / FAULTS_LISTED); the app does not serve it. Car_Position, Car_Moving_Direction and Car_Door_Status are SetPropertySubscribable (DS-COVM-B on the car). Optional Assigned_Landing_Calls (always empty: a B-EM's group takes no landing calls), Registered_Car_Call (the car's pending stops) and Landing_Door_Status (floors 1-8: the car's floor follows the car door, the others SAFETY_LOCKED) are enabled and served by the F-ELEVATOR sequence callbacks

objects.name: Mint
objects.note: F-ELEVATOR. Not a member of Maroon (a group of Lifts, isGroupOfLifts=true) - added with the spec's 'no reference' sentinel (4194303) for Elevator_Group, as clause 12.60.6 allows. Required Operation_Direction (no stack default), Passenger_Alarm and Out_Of_Service are served by the app; the optional Power_Mode and Escalator_Mode are enabled and served too, for a fuller demonstration. Status_Flags/Elevator_Group/Group_ID/Installation_ID are stack-stored, same reasoning as Mauve's

objects.name: Turquoise
objects.note: not one of the profile's named objects - added explicitly by this application, BEFORE Elevator Group 1 (Maroon), as the object Maroon's Machine_Room_ID references. BACnetStack_AddElevatorGroupObject's own doc comment reads as though the stack creates this object automatically if missing; verified against the running stack, it does not - AddElevatorGroupObject fails outright ('Create the Positive Integer Value object before adding the Elevator Group object') unless the application adds it first. Colour 'Turquoise' per docs/colour-table.md's global positive_integer_value mapping; Present_Value (required, no stack default) is served as an arbitrary plausible room id. Units defaults to no-units (accepted) since a machine-room identifier has none; Out_Of_Service is optional and left at the generic default

objects.name: Crimson
objects.note: AE-N-I-B / AE-ACK-B / AE-INFO-B. Priority, Ack_Required and Recipient_List are NOT stack DEFAULTS - they are genuinely populated by BACnetStack_AddNotificationClassObject (Priority, Ack_Required) and BACnetStack_AddRecipientToNotificationClass (Recipient_List) at start-up; marked accepted only because property-profile-reference.md's generic per-type table does not know about this object-specific host-configuration API. Unlike B-AAC (AE-CRL-B), Recipient_List is NOT made writable here - this profile has no AE-CRL-B requirement and B-EM accepts no WriteProperty of any kind
